Reward yourself with more
You’ve done the work. Now, embrace the reward. Sentra® is your well-deserved,
prize sedan with bold, muscular styling, an impressive, refined interior, and a drive
with more personalization and convenience than you ever knew you needed.

Right: Nissan Sentra® SL shown in Imperial Bronze.1

pages.text:
The power of precision
The Nissan Sentra® SR puts you in perfect sync with the road with multi-link independent
rear suspension for precise cornering and a smooth, controlled ride. Switch effortlessly
between Normal, Sport, and Eco Modes to tailor your experience — whether you’re
optimizing efficiency or embracing a more dynamic drive.2 With bold handling backed
up by advanced standard and available safety features,3 Sentra offers a driving
experience that feels intuitive, and unmistakably yours.4
Nissan Sentra® SR shown in Aspen White TriCoat / Super Black Two-tone with optional equipment and 18" Black Machined Finish accessory wheels.1

pages.text:
Available TailorFit® premium synthetic seating material
The Sentra SL offers a durable, stylish leather alternative
that’s wrinkle-resistant and soft to the touch.
Cargo Capable More space. Less effort. This is Sentra, with
60/40-split folding rear seats, a wide trunk opening, and a
large cargo area that’s designed to fit your gear.7
Fit check: flawless
Style that hits, quality that lasts. Sentra’s premium 5-seat interior not only feels plush,
but can also greet you with a prewarmed or precooled interior by activating your
climate control with the available Remote Engine Start System.6 From the available
power moonroof up top and clean lines and refined details throughout, Sentra® nails
both comfort and style at every angle.
Available Bose Premium Audio System Elevate your listening experience with
available sound enhancement which lets you hear your playlists with the rich
sound quality they deserve.
Nissan Sentra® SR shown in Charcoal Sport Leatherette with optional equipment.

pages.text:
More convenience, less clutter
Ditch the cords. Sentra’s available wireless charging and standard smartphone
integration keep you connected and powered up, hassle-free. Once paired, enjoy
a simple and seamless connection.8, 9
Available Wireless Charging Simply place your compatible smartphone on the
charging pad, and you’ll stay powered up without having to plug in.
Wireless Apple CarPlay® integration Connect your compatible iPhone® to your
Sentra without cables for a clutter-free cabin space. Access apps, navigation,
calls, music, and more on your car’s display or with Siri® voice control.8, 9, 10
Wireless Android Auto™ compatibility No cords, no hassle. Wirelessly connect
your compatible Android™ phone to map routes, send texts, jam out, and more,
Expand your view
all with the power of your voice.8, 9, 10, 11
Bring your important data into clear focus with Sentra’s available monolith display. The available
high-quality integrated 12.3-inch dual display system seamlessly puts digital gauges and infotainment
controls right where you want them. Enjoy the high-resolution, panoramic view of your messaging,
mapping, and music. Screen time never looked so good.4, 8, 9, 11
